steps.name: The Wounded Moon (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Argent] in 「Eidos Sanctuary」, then defeat [Barbatos] in 「Sanctum of the Covenant」 and obtain <Black Butterfly Remains>. Then report to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you lowered your guard...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: My apologies. I sensed a powerful presence and thought it was an enemy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The sinister energy seemed to vanish when Barbatos withdrew. Do you still sense something?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No. I must have been mistaken. What brings you back to the Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I simply wanted to visit again.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No particular reason, then. Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you haven't returned to your post, have you still not met those people?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No. Her Majesty did say it didn't matter whether I met them, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Nothing serious. There was something I wanted to find for personal reasons, so I searched the Sanctum of the Covenant. I'm sure it's there, but I couldn't find it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A black butterfly has been circling inside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw one when Barbatos disappeared. Is that it?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes... That butterfly was there when the youngest princess was led away too.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: With it, I believe we could learn what Barbatos did. And find evidence against those who plotted treason that day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll look for it. You're trusting me with this, so I'll help.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Thank you. If imperial affairs ever cause you trouble, I'll assist you. I will repay this kindness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's only finding a butterfly. You don't need to owe me anything... Anyway, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: And once you find it, please take it to the princess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which princess? Oh, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The atmosphere around the sanctum seemed to change for a moment when we mentioned the butterfly... Shall I go?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, what's that? Do you have something for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent asked me to find this and bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent hasn't changed at all... He could just concern himself with my sister. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, this is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The black butterfly that hovered around Barbatos. Argent said it might provide evidence about what happened in the past.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes. I've been searching for this for a long time too. That's why I kept exploring the Reverse Side.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I couldn't find any trace of Barbatos. He must not have shown himself. Then he appeared at the Sanctuary...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for finding it on the Sanctuary's Reverse Side. But look at this.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It looks like a butterfly, but it's actually a model.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There seems to be some kind of spell on it that affects time and space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We'll need someone's help. Someone who understands time and space... Principal Chloris won't do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Siam...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I may know someone who can offer advice.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then I'll leave it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope Siam is doing well...)

steps.name: The Wounded Moon (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Siam] in 「World Between Times」 and obtain the <Hourglass of Tears>. Then report to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome. I was hoping for someone to talk to today. You've come at just the right time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What shall we talk about? What was your homeland like?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A place as bright and beautiful as Jiendia, where people walked about with radiant smiles.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds like a lovely place to live.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It was. There was a restaurant famous for its noodles... Ah, come to think of it, my memories of that place are fading. I'd like to see it once more, though I cannot...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Haha. I don't regret losing my sight, but allow me one little boast.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: My eyesight was exceptional: 4.0 in each eye. Concentrating on my magical training improved it as well.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My eyes are good too, but I don't think they're that good...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Your heart sees more clearly than most. That is enough.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Anyway... Does Iris still smile? Of course she should, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris is...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now, tell me why you've come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Siam about the black butterfly.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'll give you something I have. Will that do? I don't know if it will help, but take it with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Siam.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But spar with me first. I've been wanting to stretch my limbs. I need to prepare, so step outside and come back in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And once you have it, leave this place immediately without another word.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Trust me and do as I say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll step out and come back.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Time and space are trembling... I should stop it for now...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, you're here. I brought something that might help. But why that expression?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It feels familiar. This object, an hourglass... It seems to come from another world...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...Does it belong to the mage who traveled with Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it does.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. Yet it feels to me as though it was found on the Reverse Side...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for getting it. Let me look.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's beyond my knowledge. I thought experience would tell me everything, but I'll have to leave this to someone who knows more than I do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do you sense anything, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little like Weiss...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That man from Eastland. Just a guess, but... is he connected to someone named Daphne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... A little...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. I think we finally have a lead. Thank you. And I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This should be for my sisters and me to handle, but you may end up drawn into it again, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right with that.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'll help too. Where are you headed now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm not sure. If someone calls, I suppose I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe. All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna. See you later. Maybe I'll get something to eat before I leave...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I suddenly so cold? It feels as though I've just returned from a frozen world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it must be my imagination. Sigh... Everything will be fine.
